project_type: pnpm monorepo with Cloudflare Workers (Durable Objects) + Vite/React 18 web app
build_system: pnpm workspaces + turbo for build orchestration. Wrangler for edge deployment. Vite for web bundling.
test_framework: None detected yet. Manual verification via browser tabs for WebSocket connections.
test_command: pnpm typecheck (TypeScript only; no unit tests exist yet)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `pnpm --filter @matinee/edge dev` in one terminal (Cloudflare Worker on localhost:8787). 2. Run `pnpm --filter @matinee/web dev` in another terminal (Vite dev server on localhost:5173). 3. Open two browser tabs to test WebSocket connections and E2EE key exchange. 4. Verify room creation returns roomId + inviteUrl. 5. Verify peer-joined/peer-left broadcasts work. 6. Check browser console for E2EE logs.
environment_constraints: Windows development environment. Cloudflare Workers uses wrangler dev with local Durable Objects. No hot module reload for edge worker (restart required). Web app has Vite HMR.
contribution_requirements: Gate A approved with conditions. M2 must implement E2EE BEFORE any messaging (FR-701, FR-702, FR-703). Cloudflare free tier requires no payment card. All changes must maintain free-tier constraints per FREE-TIER-LEDGER.md.
key_patterns: Zustand for state management (see stores/roomStore.ts). React Router v7 for routing. i18next for internationalization. Workspace protocol imports via @matinee/protocol. Web Audio API will be used in later milestones for mixer.
directory_structure: apps/edge: Cloudflare Worker entry (index.ts) + Durable Object (room-do.ts). apps/web: React app with pages/, stores/, lib/, locales/, styles/. packages/protocol: Shared TypeScript types. packages/sync-engine, subtitle-core, subtitle-pipeline, ui-tokens: Other packages for later milestones.
